evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The mandate allows payment without asking again.

itemMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for the 20-inch model. The PayPal order is for the 24-inch model (sku NVK-AL-24).

quantityMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for one unit and the order has one suitcase.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The total of $92.95 is at or below the $100.00 limit.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the cart the agent submitted, with no added items or price changes.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store shipped the 24-inch suitcase that was ordered. This answers whether the shipment matches the order, not whether the item matches the mandate.
